outcome: Likelihood of a subsequent live birth
cohort: Women with a first singleton delivery after 37 weeks of gestation from 1987 to 2009 in Denmark
finding: Compared to women with a non-instrumental vaginal delivery at first birth, those who had an elective cesarean section had a 23% decreased likelihood of a subsequent live birth.
mod_finding: Both elective and emergency cesarean sections at first birth were associated with a decreased likelihood of subsequent live birth compared to vaginal delivery.
